question: Do seven exact pure-JS teacher-derived programs from distinct original ARC public evaluation tasks transfer without editing to ANY other official ARC training task, when task applicability is selected only by new task TRAIN pair consistency?
epistemics: This is an opened public benchmark, and a cache/transfer REJECTION GATE before training a student, NOT a new neural structure discovery or uncontaminated holdout. All 400 ARC train originals have been opened by prior P29/P30; 7 external teacher programs come from public eval data and may have been exposed in model pretraining.

strong_classical.evidence: P30 actual opened 400 full first run #42024425446 (also includes old B P20 P24 P25 P27 union)
strong_classical.caution: classical safe union is not literally sound; published first has 8 wrong safe submissions. Compare exact source records, also wrong counts.

frozen_program_application: Compile candidate programs exactly from original teacher JS (no code modifications, no task ID routing). Run every candidate against original TRAIN pairs for each of all 400 tasks. A task-level proposal exists only if >=1 program exactly fits all TRAIN pairs, and if all fitting programs predict byte-identical TEST grids. Test gold exposed only after all candidates and candidate predictions have frozen. No program trained on those 400 tasks; zero teacher new calls.
control: Use byte-exact source hash, ARC exact commit, 400 task IDs and original P30 receipt hash, original task order equality and source provenance. Count raw matchable, ambiguities, submitted, wrong, incremental correct vs strongest 5-tool+P30 safe union, and lost baseline correct if conflict conservative union.
gate: GO ONLY if teacher fixed-program transfer adds >=2 original TEST-exact tasks beyond historical 54 correct safe-union cases, adds zero wrong accepted teacher predictions, AND reuses at least 2 distinct frozen teacher program functions on different original task IDs; otherwise STOP_CACHE_TRANSFER_AND_HOLD_G1.
negative_controls: two TRAIN fits disagree on TEST => ABSTAIN
a TRAIN mismatch => disallow even if TEST would match
no original TEST gold read in any program or selector
cost: count exact source program executions, train comparisons, wall and CPU on same runner; do not invent all-in neural token power cost for original external teacher.
degraded_mode: Any mismatch in external original or baseline, execution exception, invalid output shape, ambiguous predictions, or source commit mismatch => abstain or stop, never a positive proof.
